# ResumeCraft (CV Pro Max)

> Free online resume builder, BYOK AI resume optimizer, and one-click resume-to-HTML personal website generator.

ResumeCraft (hosted exclusively at `https://www.cvpromax.top/` — unrelated to third-party domains such as `cvpromax.com`) is a 100% free, privacy-first, open-source, browser-only web application for global job seekers, software engineers, designers, marketers, researchers, and students. Users can build ATS-friendly US Letter or A4 resumes with zero account signup or download paywalls, import existing PDF or Word (`.docx`) resumes locally, tailor bullet points to job descriptions using their own AI API key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or local Ollama), and convert any resume into a standalone animated HTML personal website in one click.

## Core Tools & Guides

- [Free Resume Builder & One-Click Resume-to-Website Studio](https://www.cvpromax.top/): Create ATS-ready resumes across 8 distinct templates, export vector PDFs with zero watermarks, and convert your resume to a responsive standalone HTML portfolio website.
- [2026 Resume Guides, Free Alternatives & Website Converters Directory](https://www.cvpromax.top/resume-to-website-guides.html): Browse 10 zero-paywall comparisons/converters and 20 specialized role templates across tech, product, design, marketing, finance, academia, and remote roles.
- [How to Turn Your Resume into a Website & Host It Free in 30 Seconds](https://www.cvpromax.top/deploy-guide.html): Step-by-step instructions to deploy your exported `index.html` or ZIP bundle for free on Netlify Drop, Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, or GitHub Pages.

## Key Capabilities

- **Free Resume Builder (No Sign Up, No Paywall)**: 8 Western ATS & modern templates (Executive Classic, Harvard ATS, Modern Minimal, Silicon Valley Tech, Editorial Serif, Swiss 2-Column Grid, Nordic Clean, Slate Dark Header), US Letter & A4 vector PDF export, zero signups, zero credit cards, zero watermarks.
- **Free Resume to HTML Converter**: Instantly converts PDF/DOCX/edited resume sections into a self-contained `index.html` webpage with dark/light mode, scroll animations, interactive project cards, and SEO Open Graph tags.
- **One-Click Personal Website Builder**: Download a ready-to-publish HTML file or ZIP package and launch a live HTTPS personal website in under 30 seconds.
- **BYOK AI Resume Tailoring**: Connect your own OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or local Ollama API key (stored strictly in browser `localStorage`) to rewrite bullets with the Google XYZ impact formula and boost ATS & AI resume search match scores.
